text:
The Tiki Totem was introduced in Desktop 1.2, according to the History section of the Terraria Wiki's Tiki Totem page (https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki_Totem), which lists "Desktop 1.2: Introduced." The shared note's options of 1.3 or 1.1 don't match that page, and its claim that Tiki items came with the Pirate Invasion update isn't supported by what I found. My earlier answer was wrong to say I couldn't confirm it, because the item's own wiki page gives the version directly.

CONFIDENCE: 85
